_about: Đà Nẵng official land price table (bảng giá đất), residential land (đất ở), position 1 (VT1, street frontage) only. This is the STATE table: the floor used for taxes, registration fee, compensation and land-use fees — NOT market value. Market prices are often several times higher. Only rows whose number and segment could be read from a cited page are included; positions 2–5 (alleys) were not available in any page reached, so lookups for them return Insufficient. Verify against the gazette text of the resolution before relying on a number.

decision.issuer: HĐND thành phố Đà Nẵng (khóa XI)
decision.legal_basis: Land Law 2024 with Nghị quyết 254/2025/QH15 Điều 7 (provincial council sets the land price table from 2026-01-01). The land price table is now a council resolution (NQ-HĐND), not a UBND decision; UBND issues the adjustment coefficient (Quyết định 101/2026/QĐ-UBND, effective 2026-07-15).
decision.note: Tiền Phong reported 37 of 94 communes/wards asked to amend the table soon after it was issued — expect revisions.
